text:
jules: design review: compact roles grid — hover shows a faint 'ghost ring' around disabled chips. in light mode it reads as intended but on dark mode it disappears. also users in mobile keep tapping chips expecting an action. thoughts? :thinking_face:
kaito: can you paste the frame id? want to compare with the current hover token.
jules: figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/roles-compact?node-id=88%3A12 frame 'compact-roles-hover-ghost'
meera: quick a11y scan: ghost ring is 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on dark backgrounds — contrast too low and not perceivable to screen reader users. suggestion: make ring 2px or use a 1px ring + subtle backdrop filter. also ensure keyboard focus has a distinct outline (not same as hover).
colin: engineering note: increasing ring thickness impacts layout when chips are tightly packed; but we can use box-shadow to avoid layout shift. cost is minimal.
jules: microcopy: when chip is disabled because of SSO we currently show tooltip 'Enforced by SSO'. feels terse. proposed variants: A) 'Managed by your identity provider' B) 'SSO-managed — contact admin to change' C) 'Not editable here. See audit history for changes.' prefer C for actionability.
kaito: C is good but maybe split: tooltip short + actionable link in popover. tooltip: 'Managed by SSO' and popover: 'Not editable here. View audit history or contact your admin.' Popover on click would be accessible on keyboard and touch.
meera: popover is OK but must avoid trapping focus. it should be a simple non-modal flyout with `role="dialog"` only if we trap. also add `aria-describedby` on chips pointing to explanatory text for screen readers, and the popover trigger must be reachable via keyboard.
colin: implementation feasibility: popover requires small JS to manage focus but doable. deep-linking to audit is easier surface-wise: `/audit?event=role_assignment&role=Admin&source=roles_grid`. can do that first iteration.
jules: mobile nuance: on small screens chips wrap and hover doesn't exist. users tap. proposal: make tap on disabled chip open the popover with audit link. if someone taps multiple times we shouldn't show snackbars saying 'no-op'. instead show the popover.
kaito: agree. prefer deterministic behavior: hover -> tooltip, click/tap -> popover with audit link. also track analytics: roles_grid.disabled_chip_click.
meera: accessibility bot note: ensure popover is announced when it opens (e.g., `aria-live` region or focus the first heading inside popover). also avoid using color alone to convey disabled state — add a textual hint like 'SSO managed' visually present for screen reader users via `sr-only` text too.
a11y-bot: automated scan summary: frame compact-roles-hover-ghost - issues: 1) hover ring contrast < 3:1 on dark mode; 2) tooltip text relies on title attribute; 3) disabled chips removed from tab order. Recommendations: increase ring opacity to reach 4.5:1 equivalence, implement accessible tooltip pattern (`aria-describedby` with DOM element), keep disabled chips focusable with `aria-disabled="true"` and `tabindex="0"` so popover is reachable, or provide separate focusable help control. Suggested audit deep-link: `/audit?event=role_assignment&role=<roleName>&source=roles_grid`.
colin: for keyboard we can make chip focusable when disabled and intercept Enter/Space to open popover that links to audit. fallback: if we don't want disabled focusable, render a small inline 'View changes' link after the chip group.
jules: decision draft: 1) replace ghost ring with 1px ring + 6px shadow (no layout shift) and bump opacity on dark backgrounds; 2) tooltip becomes short: 'Managed by SSO'; 3) click/tap on disabled chip opens small, non-modal popover with copy 'Not editable here. View audit history or contact your admin.' 4) popover contains deep-link to audit using query pattern above; 5) chips remain in tab order with `aria-disabled=true` and Enter/Space opens popover; 6) for mobile ensure tapping opens popover.
kaito: timeline: can we get final copy + figma updates by Wed EOD? we'll scope dev work for the sprint after next.
meera: quick QA checklist for implementers: - focusable disabled chip with `aria-disabled` - popover opens on Enter/Space/tap and focuses first focusable element - popover has `aria-label` like 'Role details for Admin' - audit link uses `aria-label` 'Open audit history filtered to role Admin' - no reliance on `title` attribute - test in dark and light modes for 4.5:1 contrast - mobile tap behavior documented
jules: i'll update figma and paste final copy here. here's initial popover copy: 'Not editable here. Role assignments are managed by your identity provider. View audit history or contact your admin to change this.' link text: 'View audit history' short alt: 'Audit history'.
a11y-bot: run-after patch checklist: confirm keyboard nav, run color contrast tests, verify SR announcement of popover opening, ensure analytics event fired on disabled chip interaction.
colin: ok i'll spike the popover behavior prototype and mock out the audit link params.
jules: thanks everyone 44d i'll drop updated frames and a short prototype in Figma when ready.
